description: Experimental prerelease candidate that reads and writes record version 3, the token carrier of spec/token-carrier.md: the seventeen-field body carried behind a BRC-162 token prefix as a token of one unit, read beside versions 1 and 2. @bsv/dpp-core 0.3.0-beta.8 parses, builds and verifies carried states and reports the carrier reason codes; @bsv/dpp-overlay-topics 0.4.0-beta.10 admits them under the carrier rules, indexes the token id, declares dpp-record version 3 and serves overlay contract 0.11.0-draft; it also finds peers through the overlay discovery protocols when configured, advertises itself from a separate advertiser key when configured, asks again for outputs it left behind, and declares single-operator@2 when one administration pulls from peers. @bsv/dpp-profiles 0.3.0-beta.8 carries the operator profile single-operator@2 added on 8 October 2026 and is otherwise unchanged; @bsv/vsc 0.2.0-beta.5 is unchanged, on @bsv/sdk 2.8.10 under the Apache License 2.0. Claim, anchor and acceptance formats, frozen profiles and the custody profile are unchanged, and the set claims native-baseline@2 with the version 3 reader claim required beside it. Package publication does not establish that any wallet or index outside this repository handles a carried state, nor federated operation or product qualification.

dependencies.name: mongodb
dependencies.note: the reference persistence of the index node, replaceable

dependencies.name: @bsv/wallet-toolbox-client
dependencies.note: the application service's wallet, and from this set an optional dependency of @bsv/dpp-overlay-topics for advertising, at the same version; npm install --omit=optional leaves it out

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-core
packages.role: the record model (both versions), signatures, chain verification, the verification report, the native claim, the generic anchor, the managed acceptance record, publisher policy and evidence packages

support.notes: Depends on @bsv/sdk only and imports no Node built-in; a browser bundle is not tested and not promised.
Normative JSON schemas copied byte for byte from contracts; relative schema references remain alongside one another.

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-overlay-topics
packages.role: the topic managers, lookup services, storage adapters, capabilities, history, bounded export, complete export, retraction and synchronisation of the index, as a library; the node itself ships as the image

support.notes: Server only: Node built-ins, the overlay engine and the MongoDB driver. Importing never starts the HTTP host, which is reached by path as dist/index.js.

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-profiles
packages.role: the industry, exchange and operator profiles as frozen manifests with generated schemas and consumer documents, the lifecycle mapping for both record versions, and the GS1 identifier helpers; the GS1 discovery helpers, the interoperability manifests, the shared evidence shapes, the declarative applicability evaluator and the deterministic passport projection; structural profile change reports and version 4 cross-field data review

support.notes: Reads its data files through the Node file system; the one runtime dependency is the RFC 8785 canonicaliser.
The manifest, identity, exchange, operator and interoperability schemas and the pinned GS1 resolver schemas.
Generated payload schemas, consumer documents and mapping inventories.
The digests every published file is held to.

packages.name: @bsv/vsc
packages.role: the VSC draft compatibility profile with its owned context and schema artefacts and the two proof suites; the EPCIS source helpers with the pinned EPCIS 2.0.1 artefacts (./epcis-source) and the external ecdsa-rdfc-2019 credential verifier (./exchange)

support.notes: Server only: reads its artefacts through the file system and decompresses status lists with node:zlib.
The external ecdsa-rdfc-2019 credential verifier; server only for the same reasons.
The EPCIS source helpers; server only for the same reasons.
The owned context and schemas, the pinned EPCIS and W3C artefacts and the external passport context and schema, each with a notice file naming its digest.

alsoSupported: owner-signed transfer (spec/custody.md section 4) for version 1 lineages

serviceInterface.note: PassportService in the reference application, whose source is not public, is the account-agnostic entry point over the writer's journal; it consumes the packages above and is not itself published in this set.

artefacts.pins: the baseline this set claims, with every fixture digest
the report schema and reason codes
the shared evidence, measurement, certification, document and language shapes
the carried record: the token prefix, the version 3 body, the token id, the burn and the migration rule
one carried genesis and value output of record version 3 with twelve refusals
a five-state carried lineage, twelve refusals and the burn
the verification report for nine carried evidence cases
the proposed baseline for the carried record, with every fixture digest

consumers.name: the reference application
consumers.consumes: exact npm dependencies; adoption of @bsv/dpp-profiles 0.3.0-beta.8 and explicit profile activation require a separate application change
consumers.note: the example consumer with sector workflows; package installation, supported readers and selected writers are separate adoption decisions

consumers.name: the reference registry
consumers.consumes: the packages as vendored tarballs, to be replaced by the published packages of this set

consumers.name: a second stack under the same administration
consumers.consumes: the packages through public entry points at exact public registry versions
consumers.note: an index, registry, writer and reader application built from the public documentation, repository and packages alone; a reference consumer under the same administration, not an independent implementation, and no federated operation claim
